title: Data Scientist, Analytics Enablement
desc:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Strategic Finance Data Science team helps OpenAI understand business performance and make informed decisions about growth, revenue, and resource allocation. We partner with Strategic Finance, Data Engineering, and business teams to build trusted metrics, explain what is changing, and support forecasting, planning, pricing, and investment decisions.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Data Scientist, Analytics Enablement to turn complex financial and business questions into reliable data products, clear analyses, and actionable recommendations. You will work across the analytical workflow: define the question, establish trustworthy metrics and datasets, investigate the drivers, and help partners act on the findings.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will combine the technical depth of analytics engineering with strong analytical judgment and close partnership with Strategic Finance. Your work will serve both executive reviews and the teams making day-to-day business decisions.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Define and maintain trusted metrics and analytical datasets for revenue, usage, customer performance, compute consumption, and margin, with clear definitions and appropriate product, customer, and cohort detail.

 - Build automated dashboards and recurring reporting that help Finance leaders and operating teams understand performance, spot changes, and prioritize investigation.

 - Explain movements in business results and variances against expectations by examining underlying drivers, validating data quality, and distinguishing evidence from assumptions.

 - Translate ambiguous questions about growth, retention, monetization, pricing, and resource efficiency into structured analyses and practical recommendations.

 - Partner with forecasting specialists and Finance to provide reliable inputs, driver analyses, and scenario assumptions for forecasts and long-range plans.

 - Work with Data Engineering to improve the quality and usability of underlying data, and develop reusable analytical models and workflows that reduce manual effort.

 - Communicate findings clearly, align stakeholders on trade-offs, and follow through to understand whether the analysis or data product improved the decision.




YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

 - Have strong SQL and analytical data-modeling skills, and experience turning large, complex datasets into reliable analyses and reusable data products.

 - Can reason carefully about metrics, cohorts, denominators, measurement changes, and uncertainty, and investigate whether an unexpected result reflects the business or the data.

 - Have built dashboards or recurring reporting used by business partners, and can explain the decisions they enabled.

 - Bring sound business judgment and can independently scope an ambiguous problem, prioritize the work, and deliver an end-to-end solution.

 - Communicate technical findings clearly and work effectively with Finance, data scientists, engineers, and other business partners.

 - Can use Python or a comparable analytical tool to investigate data and automate repetitive work.

 



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

title: Data Analyst
desc: Current Employees: If you are currently employed at any of the Universities of Wisconsin, log in to Workday to apply through the internal application process. Job Category: Academic Staff Employment Type: Regular Job Profile: Policy and Planning Analyst I Job Summary: The University of Wisconsin-Madison School of Education is one of the nation's leading schools of education, recognized for excellence across the arts, education, and health. Guided by the Wisconsin Idea, the School advances teaching, research, and public service through 10 academic departments and a broad network of research, outreach, and administrative units that support students, faculty, staff, and communities across Wisconsin and beyond. Reporting to the Director of the Office of Data and Analytics (ODA), the Data Analyst supports strategic planning and decision-making across the School through analysis of academic, budget and finance, human resources, research, and student data. Using institutional data and information from a variety of campus sources, the analyst develops and maintains reports, dashboards, and analytical tools that provide actionable insights for School leadership, academic departments, and administrative units. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented and analytical professional who is a critical thinker, self-starter, and collaborative partner with a passion for using data to support informed decision-making and continuous improvement. Examples of areas of responsibility include: Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards and reports that support School of Education leadership, academic departments, and administrative units’ decision-making. Analyze trends and patterns across academic, student, research, financial, and other operational data. Support reporting and analysis related to enrollment, retention, scholarships, post-graduation outcomes, course access, graduate education, research activity, and departmental and budget metrics. Prepare analysis and reporting for program review, accreditation, rankings submissions, and strategic planning initiatives. Key Job Responsibilities: Tracks sources of information relevant to policy development affecting the higher education sector Designs and develops policy analyses and briefing papers for unit leadership Reviews, monitors, and evaluates policies and data analyses to present as evidence-based support for unit bids, applications, and decision-making Works with business intelligence/analyst function in computing services to develop data visualization and business intelligence capability Provides project support for, and further enhancement of, unit initiatives Assists in establishing guidelines and procedures to ensure adequacy, quality, and reliability of information sources Department: School of Education, Office of Data and Analytics Compensation: The minimum starting salary is $75,000, with flexibility based on qualifications and experience. Employees in this position can expect to receive benefits such as: Generous vacation, holidays, and paid time off Competitive insurance and savings accounts Retirement benefits Please review the summary of benefits for more information. Required Qualifications: One year of professional experience analyzing large datasets to answer organizational, operational, policy, or research questions and produce reports and analyses. Proficiency querying relational databases using SQL or similar database programming languages. Experience working with large datasets from operational data systems. Experience assessing data quality, validating analytical results, and identifying and investigating discrepancies across data sources and reporting systems. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and responsibilities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail. Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel (including data analysis tools such as Pivot Tables and Power Query) and PowerPoint. Preferred Qualifications: Experience using data and analytical methods to evaluate policy or program outcomes and inform policy development and program evaluation. One year of experience working in higher education administration. One year of experience applying statistical analysis methods and/or developing reproducible data analyses using statistical software such as R, Python, SAS, Stata, or SPSS. Experience developing end-user focused dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using Tableau, Power BI, or Qlik or similar business intelligence tools. Experience with high-stakes reporting and responding to compliance and regulatory requirements. Experience working with stakeholders to define analytical questions, clarify requirements, and translate business needs into data analyses. Demonstrated ability to communicate complex analytical results to technical and non-technical audiences through written reports, presentations, and data visualizations. Experience developing and maintaining analytical and technical documentation, including the use of version-control tools such as GitLab. Interest in exploring the appropriate use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools to improve efficiency in workflows. Demonstrated ability to develop and sustain productive working relationships. Demonstrated ability to learn new software, analytical methods, and skills. Education: Required: Bachelor's degree. Preferred: Master's degree and/or a degree in higher education administration, education policy, applied social sciences, or a related field. How to Apply: To apply for this position, select either "I am a current employee" or "I am not a current employee" under Apply Now. You will then be prompted to upload your application materials. To be considered for this position, applicants must upload the following materials: Resume/Curriculum Vitae Cover Letter Your application materials should highlight your experience relating to the qualifications referenced above. Important: The application has only one attachment field. Please upload all required documents in that field, either as a single combined file or as multiple files in the same upload area. All required application materials must be submitted for your application to be considered. Please note that successful applicants are responsible for ensuring their eligibility to work in the United States (i.e. a citizen or national of the United States, a lawful permanent resident, a foreign national authorized to work in the United States without need of employer sponsorship) on or before the effective date of appointment. title: Machine Learning Engineer - MoneyLion
desc:
About Gen:

Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries.



Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results.

When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs.

At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage.

If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen.



About the Role

The Kuala Lumpur office is the technology powerhouse of MoneyLion. We pride ourselves on innovative initiatives and thrive in a fast paced and challenging environment. Join our multicultural team of visionaries and industry rebels in disrupting the traditional finance industry!

We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer who is technically proficient in programming to build machine learning systems and maintain high performing machine learning models in production. Designing machine learning systems requires that you, as the machine learning engineer, is able to frame business problems and design machine learning solutions that can effectively bring value to the company.  You will prototype, implement and experiment with machine learning methods to solve business use cases. You will lead efforts to automate, architect and optimise machine learning processes and workflows. You will also help define, execute and enforce best practices for test-driven model development processes for the entire Data Science team in MoneyLion.



Key Responsibilities

 - Able to frame and contextualize machine learning problems

 - Research, build and design machine learning systems and models that can solve business problems

 - Assess, understand and analyse data to select appropriate datasets for data modelling and testing

 - Identify, prototype and implement appropriate machine learning algorithms and tools to improve our products

 - Design, execute and monitor machine learning model experiments and metrics

 - Perform statistical analysis to evaluate and prove business impact of modelling improvements 

 - Automate, architect and orchestrate machine learning processes and pipelines

 - Monitor, optimise and maintain machine learning solutions in production

 - Enrich existing machine learning libraries and model development frameworks to empower model development in MoneyLion

 - Work with MLOps Engineers and Data Scientists to improve systems designs and architectures

 - Enforce test-driven development and advocate engineering best practices to reduce technical debt in machine learning systems

 - Develop tools and internal libraries to facilitate model governance over the machine learning development lifecycle
   
   

About You

 - Strong mathematical, statistical or actuarial background

 - Good programming knowledge and software engineering skills

 - Must have hands on experience in machine learning, predictive analytics and statistical modelling

 - Experience developing and deploying machine learning models in production.

 - Adept at problem solving and troubleshooting using both textbook methods and novel viewpoints

 - Proficient in Python and SQL

 - Proficient with machine learning libraries and frameworks such as scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM

 - Preferably have experience in building machine learning systems and workflows

 - Preferably familiar and have experience with MLOps tools such as DVC, MLFlow, Metaflow, Seldon, BentoML

 - Preferably familiar and have experience with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes.

 - Solid communication and collaboration skills.
   
   

What's Next...

After you submit your application, you can expect the following steps in the recruitment process:

 1. Online Technical Test

 2. Take-Home Assessment

 3. Interview & Discussion of Take-Home Assessment - Hiring Manager (Virtual or face-to-face)

title: Photonic Product Engineer for Analytics and ML

Working in a vertically integrated organization, there will be opportunity to help products achieve industry leading performance through engineering optimization end-to-end. The position is based in Allentown, Pennsylvania. Develop, improve, and maintain data visualization platforms to enable faster detection of line trends Mine large manufacturing and test datasets, from wafer through module, to find yield drivers and failure signatures. Deploy ML algorithms and AI agents to improve our ability to uncover correlations in the large data sets generated by the manufacturing line, spanning chip to module, including anomaly detection, yield prediction, root-cause analysis and early detection of line drift. Perform statistical data analysis to characterize and help improve product yields and validate ML algorithm outputs Identify opportunities for automation of analyses and engineering tasks using GenAI and workflow automation, working with other AI/ML partners to help drive best practices within the group Position Requirements M.S. or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Photonics, Applied Physics/Mathematics, Computer Science or Data Science, with 3+ years of experience applying data analytics or ML (Ph.D. can count toward the experience). title: Applied AI Engineer, People
desc: Atomic Machines is building the Matter Compiler™, the first in a new class of AI-native, all-digital manufacturing systems that build working machines directly from code. The Matter Compiler  (MC) is aimed at micro-machines: motors and gears the size of a grain of sand, robots small enough to work inside the body, cooling built directly into the chips that run AI, and the many devices like them that have been waiting on a way to build them. Its first product is PrimeSwitch™, an electromechanical power relay the size of a button battery that carries 150 amps continuous current and opens in 50 microseconds, about a thousand times faster than a conventional contactor. Founded by Jeff Holden — serial entrepreneur, ex-Amazon SVP and Uber’s first Chief Product Officer — the company has raised $250 million to date. Atomic Machines is based in the San Francisco Bay Area, with offices in Emeryville and Santa Clara. About The Role: This role reports to the Head of Strategic Growth and can be full-time or contract. You’ll be the first engineer embedded in our People team, working directly with leadership and building agents that reach every corner of the company. As we scale, there’s real opportunity to work across functions and embed with other teams. Our goal is to build one of the first AI-native People Operations systems inside a scaling technology company. Instead of a large administrative HR organization, we’re building a small, high-leverage People team powered by smart systems, operational excellence, and AI-enabled processes we invent as we go. Our People team knows our Atomizers (that’s what we call our people) but lacks the technical skills to build systems that scale our people practices. You’ll be the person who turns our ideas into working tools, uncovers redundancy, gets more out of the platforms we already use, and builds AI proficiency across the team. This role is about efficiency, clear metrics, and leaving the team more capable than you found it. What You’ll Do: Build agents and automations. Ship agents and workflows across the employee lifecycle, from recruiting and onboarding to benefits and People Operations. Shape our People tech stack. Connect Greenhouse, Metaview, Justworks, Slack, and Google Workspace, define how People data flows between them, and get the most from what we already use. Own People metrics and dashboards. Build clear, trusted views of hiring pipeline, time to fill, recruiter capacity, headcount, and organizational health so leaders can make decisions quickly. Find redundancy. Map how our team actually works, spot repeated manual steps and tool overlap, and fix them. Support a fast-scaling recruiting function. Help us keep up with a high volume of open roles without losing quality or candidate experience. Teach AI fluency. Run hands-on sessions, write simple playbooks and build templates so non-technical teammates can use Claude, ChatGPT and agents confidently. Keep exploring. Stay on top of new AI tools and practices, test them, and bring forward what's actually useful. Handle data responsibly. Treat employee and candidate data with the care and confidentiality it needs. What You Bring: A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience. 1–2 years of experience, including internships or substantial projects, building AI agents or LLM-powered workflows that can scale across an organization. Strong proficiency with Claude Code, plus comfort with Python, SQL and APIs. Experience building dashboards or reporting from messy data. A track record of building efficient, repeatable practices that scale, not one-off scripts. The ability to explain technical ideas in plain language to non-engineers, and patience teaching them. Curiosity about how teams work, and a habit of asking "why do we do it this way?" Good judgment about privacy and handling sensitive information. Nice to Have: Familiarity with both Claude and ChatGPT ecosystems, including MCP connectors, custom GPTs or Projects. Experience with workflow tools or BI platforms. Interest in people operations, talent, or organizational design. Why Join: You'll build agents that reach every team in the company, with real ownership from day one. Your work will shape how a fast-growing deep-tech company hires and supports its people. You'll have the space to experiment with the newest AI tools and see your impact right away. The compensation for this position also includes equity and benefits. Salary Range $110,000 — $150,000 USD Atomic Machines

Excellent computer skills – is an expert in Excel (charts, formulas, graphs) and able to learn new systems and programs.
